name: Mario Kart Wiicompiled
summary:
A native PC port of Mario Kart Wii, made with static recompilation. There is no emulator, interpreter or JIT at runtime, and no Nintendo code or game data is included: the translation runs on your own legally dumped PAL, NTSC-U or NTSC-J disc image.

Rendering is native, through aurora, a source-level GameCube and Wii compatibility layer, with high internal resolution, any aspect ratio and an unlocked framerate with experimental frame interpolation. An in-game settings bar covers internal resolution, controller assignment and full button mapping for all four ports, Dolphin-syntax input expressions with GCPadNew.ini import, vibration, volume and optional music ducking. Real Wii Remotes can be paired over Bluetooth, and the official Wii U / Switch GameCube adapter is supported.
